basic_details.job_title: NIPER Raebareli Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Raebareli (NIPER-R) will hold a walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 at 10:00 am at NIPER-Raebareli (transit campus), Lucknow, and candidates reporting after 11:00 AM will not be considered. The interview is for one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) post on a purely contractual basis, with pay of Rs. 56,000 plus HRA as applicable.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 35 years. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years in the case of SC/ST/OBC/women and physically handicapped candidates as per Govt of India norms. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age.

content_sections.heading: About NIPER Raebareli
content_sections.text: NIPER-R is described in the notice as an autonomous Institute of National Importance set up by the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Govt. of India, by an act of Parliament, to impart high-quality education and research in Pharmaceutical Sciences. The post is under an ICMR intermediate grant for the project "Translational Advancement and Optimisation of Oral Sustained-Release Microparticle Platform for Parkinson's Therapy". It works under the supervision of Dr. Ashok K. Datusalia, Associate Professor, Department of Pharmacology and Toxicology.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One post of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) is to be filled. The notice describes it as a purely contractual walk-in engagement. Essential qualification is either of the following. The qualification must be from a recognized Board/University/Institute. MS Pharm (Pharmacology & Toxicology/Regulatory Toxicology/Biotechnology), M Pharm (Pharmacology), MTech (Biotechnology/Bioscience), MD (Pharmacology/Pharmacology & Toxicology), MVSc (Pharmacology/Pathology/Biotechnology) or MSc (Life Science/Biochemistry/Neuroscience/Biotechnology/Biological Science), with a minimum of 60% aggregate or 6.75 CGPA. OR a second class post-graduate degree in the aforementioned disciplines with Ph.D. The notice says preference shall be given to a candidate with: PhD degree in relevant discipline and qualified in GPAT/GATE/CSIR-NET/CSIR-JRF/DHR-BRET or equivalent national exam. Experience in Drug Discovery, NCE screening; in-vivo neuro-pharmacology models and behavioral experiments; mammalian cell culture, transfection experiments. Demonstrated writing skills with publications in highly reputed journals related to the project/work. Aptitude for strong commitment to experimental research, mentoring and knowledge dissemination to the lab members; to run the project independently. The maximum age limit is 35 years. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years in the case of SC/ST/OBC/women and physically handicapped candidates as per Govt of India norms. On the recommendation of the Selection Committee, the competent authority may relax all or any of the requirements related to age and experience in exceptionally meritorious cases. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age.

rows.duration: Initially for one year, extendable up to three years based on performance or till project duration

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The prescribed application form (format attached to the notice) with complete information. CV. All photocopies of certificates/documents regarding educational qualifications, work experience, etc. Self-attested copies of date of birth proof, degrees, certificates, mark sheets and experience certificates, as the notice names them.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in this area of research may send the prescribed application form with complete information and attachments (certificates/documents) along with CV in advance to the PI by email at [email protected] . They should also bring the application form, CV and photocopies of certificates to the interview. The notice gives no last date for the email.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The interview is on 26 November 2026 at 10:00 am at NIPER-Raebareli (transit campus), Lucknow. It will be conducted preferably in physical mode. A highly interested candidate may request to appear online by emailing the PI at [email protected] with the completed application form and relevant documents. NIPER Raebareli reserves the right to fix suitable criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates, and the project team may put any screening criteria if large numbers of applications are received.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications, or those without relevant supporting documents, will not be interviewed. No TA/DA will be given to candidates called for the interview. The offer is purely temporary, for one year initially and extended further till the project duration based on performance. It does not confer any right for absorption in NIPER Raebareli. For further information, applicants may contact the PI directly by email. The notice gives the institute address as National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research, Raebareli, Bijnor-Sisendi Road, Sarojini Nagar, Near CRPF Base Camp, Lucknow (UP)- 226002. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

faq.question: Q1. When is the NIPER Raebareli walk-in interview for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026 (26.11.2026) at 10:00 am.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: The interview time is 10:00 am. Candidates reporting after 11:00 AM will not be considered for the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is at NIPER-Raebareli (transit campus), Lucknow.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy, for Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical).

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the post?
faq.answer: MS Pharm, M Pharm, MTech, MD, MVSc or MSc in the listed disciplines with a minimum 60% aggregate or 6.75 CGPA, OR a second class post-graduate degree in those disciplines with Ph.D.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years. It is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/women and physically handicapped candidates as per Govt of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 56,000 (56000/-) plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a purely contractual, temporary position, for one year initially and extendable up to three years based on performance or till project duration. It confers no right for absorption in NIPER Raebareli.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents should I send and bring?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application form with attachments and CV to the PI by email in advance. Also bring the form, CV and photocopies of certificates and documents on qualifications and work experience.

faq.question: Q10. Can I appear for the interview online?
faq.answer: The interview is preferably in physical mode. A highly interested candidate may request online appearance by emailing the PI with the completed application form and relevant documents.
